findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明產業已有整併與新進入者（含非傳統競爭者），可能加劇競爭與價格壓力，並有來自非傳統製造商的顛覆性技術風險。
findings.excerpt: There has been consolidation and new entrants (including non-traditional competitors) within our industries and there may be future consolidation and new entrants, either of which could result in increased competition and pricing pressures and significantly alter the dynamics of the competitive landscape in which we operate.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱公司監控主要競爭對手與客戶以評估相對表現；未揭露量化份額數字。
findings.excerpt: We monitor key competitors and customers in order to gauge relative performance and the outlook for the future.

findings.claim: 次要來源稱 Vertiv 純資料中心冷卻聚焦造成價格壓力，浸沒式冷卻可能使設備商品化；Trane 以收購 Stellar Energy Americas、LiquidStack 回應。

note: 兩次搜尋均未找到量化的份額消長來源；未見明確指名的新進入者搶單報導。次要來源提及 Carrier、JCI、Daikin、Vertiv 為競爭者，但為聚合站、未讀原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
